dashboard_overview.title: Dashboard Overview
dashboard_overview.contextual_tip: Start with profile strength, unanswered Q&A, and lead response time. Those three indicators drive most operator outcomes.

dashboard_listings.title: Managing Your Facilities
dashboard_listings.contextual_tip: A complete, accurate listing is the foundation for ranking, trust, and qualified family inquiries.

dashboard_leads.title: Lead Lifecycle and Estimated Impact
dashboard_leads.contextual_tip: Keep lead statuses current within one business day to preserve reporting accuracy and reliable benchmarks.

dashboard_qa.title: Official Q&A Responses
dashboard_qa.contextual_tip: Treat official answers as public policy statements. Be accurate, current, and aligned with your facility operations.

dashboard_billing.title: Billing and Plan Management
dashboard_billing.contextual_tip: When a billing action fails, use the exact error CTA first. It routes to the shortest resolution path.

dashboard_help.title: Help Center
dashboard_help.contextual_tip: Use this center as your operating manual. Search by workflow, error code, or metric name.

overview-reading-kpis.title: How to Read Dashboard KPIs
overview-reading-kpis.content_md:
### KPI trust model
Every KPI uses a trust layer before display.

- Each card shows **Data as of** timestamp.
- If confidence is below threshold, you will see **Gathering Insights**.
- Use the **(i)** icon on metrics to view methodology labels.

### Operator action
If a KPI is in placeholder state, improve source data quality first before making strategy decisions.

overview-priority-actions.title: Priority Action Order
overview-priority-actions.content_md:
### Suggested sequence
1. Resolve profile completeness gaps.
2. Respond to new leads.
3. Publish official Q&A updates.
4. Review weekly trend movement.

This order provides the fastest operational impact for most facilities.

overview-data-freshness.title: Understanding Data Freshness
overview-data-freshness.content_md:
### Time display policy
- High-frequency data uses relative labels like **Updated 5m ago**.
- Lower-frequency benchmark data uses absolute labels like **As of Feb 14, 2026**.

### Troubleshooting stale cards
- Confirm lead statuses are updated.
- Confirm recent listing edits were saved or published.
- Refresh after one processing cycle.

overview-daily-operator-routine.title: Daily Operator Routine
overview-daily-operator-routine.content_md:
### 15-minute daily checklist
1. Check new leads and mark response state.
2. Answer highest-priority Q&A items.
3. Validate profile changes made by staff.
4. Review alerts for ranking or confidence changes.

### Target
Maintain lead and response data freshness to keep trust metrics stable.

overview-weekly-review-routine.title: Weekly Review Routine
overview-weekly-review-routine.content_md:
### Weekly operations review
- Compare this week vs prior week lead volume.
- Audit profile health score movement.
- Identify top 3 unanswered family concerns from Q&A.
- Review billing slot assignments and plan utilization.

### Output
Create a weekly action list with owner and due date for each item.

overview-alert-priority-matrix.title: Alert Priority Matrix
overview-alert-priority-matrix.content_md:
### Severity guide
- **P1**: Data integrity or access issues blocking operations.
- **P2**: Lead workflow or billing blockers with workaround.
- **P3**: Content or UX issues with low immediate impact.

### Escalation
If unresolved in one business day, open support with logs, timestamps, and facility ID.

listings-status-badges.title: Listing Status Badges
listings-status-badges.content_md:
### Badge meanings
- **Verified**: Listing is active and trusted.
- **Pending Review**: Claim submitted and under validation.
- **Offline**: Listing not publicly visible yet.

Status badges are tied to verification state and profile quality rules.

listings-edit-workflow.title: Editing Workflow
listings-edit-workflow.content_md:
### Save and publish behavior
Use **Save Draft** to stage updates and **Publish Live** to push changes.

If versioning is unavailable for a record, Save applies live directly.

listings-photos-best-practices.title: Photo Best Practices
listings-photos-best-practices.content_md:
### Media checklist
- Include exterior, rooms, dining, and common spaces.
- Prefer recent images with accurate representation.
- Avoid heavy filters or misleading staging.

Facilities with complete galleries generally see stronger engagement quality.

listings-profile-health-checklist.title: Profile Health Checklist
listings-profile-health-checklist.content_md:
### Required completeness blocks
- Facility description
- Contact details
- Pricing range
- Care types
- Amenities
- Photos

### Publish rule
Complete core blocks before promotion-focused edits. This prevents ranking volatility.

listings-address-change-policy.title: Address Change Policy
listings-address-change-policy.content_md:
### Why address is controlled
Address updates require verification to preserve directory trust and map consistency.

### Submit request
Include current address, requested address, reason, and documentation.

listings-publish-quality-gate.title: Pre-Publish Quality Gate
listings-publish-quality-gate.content_md:
### Before publishing
1. Validate phone and website.
2. Confirm pricing is current.
3. Confirm at least one recent photo set.
4. Confirm no stale policy answers in Q&A.

Publishing without this check can reduce operator trust with families.

leads-status-definitions.title: Lead Status Definitions
leads-status-definitions.content_md:
### Standard statuses
- **New**
- **Contacted**
- **Tour Scheduled**
- **Tour Completed**
- **Moved In**
- **Lost**

Use consistent status definitions across your team.

leads-roi-methodology.title: Estimated Impact Methodology
leads-roi-methodology.content_md:
### Estimated impact model
The model combines verified lead activity with configurable baseline assumptions.

Guardrails:
- Hard bounds: **0.5% to 20.0%**
- Safe zone: **1.0% to 15.0%**

Outside safe zone, a **Custom Baseline Applied** warning appears.

leads-response-time.title: Response Time Guidance
leads-response-time.content_md:
### Operational target
Respond within one business day.

### Why it matters
Delays reduce lead quality and confidence in trend reporting.

leads-conversion-funnel-playbook.title: Conversion Funnel Playbook
leads-conversion-funnel-playbook.content_md:
### Funnel optimization sequence
1. Increase complete profile coverage.
2. Improve first-response consistency.
3. Reduce friction to tour scheduling.
4. Track loss reasons and act on patterns.

### Weekly KPI checks
- Intent to conversion trend
- Tour completion ratio
- Lost lead reason concentration

leads-followup-cadence.title: Recommended Follow-Up Cadence
leads-followup-cadence.content_md:
### Suggested cadence
- Day 0: Initial response
- Day 1: Follow-up with scheduling options
- Day 3: Clarify care fit and pricing
- Day 7: Close loop or mark outcome

Keep notes brief and factual to improve team handoffs.

leads-low-confidence-recovery.title: Recovering from Low Confidence Metrics
leads-low-confidence-recovery.content_md:
### When cards show Gathering Insights
- Verify minimum data threshold not met.
- Backfill missing lead statuses.
- Ensure duplicate handling is correct.

### Recovery target
Reach threshold with clean data before using benchmark comparisons.

qa-official-response-guidelines.title: Official Response Guidelines
qa-official-response-guidelines.content_md:
### Quality standards
- Be accurate and operationally true.
- Use plain language and clear next steps.
- Avoid unsupported claims.

Official responses represent the facility publicly.

qa-stale-answer-policy.title: Stale Answer Policy
qa-stale-answer-policy.content_md:
### Refresh interval
Answers older than six months should be reviewed and refreshed to maintain verified information quality.

qa-notification-expectations.title: Q&A Notification Expectations
qa-notification-expectations.content_md:
### Notification behavior
Question alerts and stale-answer reminders are sent by email according to notification settings.

qa-answer-quality-rubric.title: Answer Quality Rubric
qa-answer-quality-rubric.content_md:
### Rubric
- **Completeness**: addresses full question scope
- **Specificity**: includes concrete policy detail
- **Clarity**: easy to read and non-ambiguous
- **Actionability**: includes next step for family

Score each response before publishing for consistency.

qa-sensitive-topic-handling.title: Handling Sensitive Topics
qa-sensitive-topic-handling.content_md:
### Sensitive topics
For pricing disputes, staffing complaints, or medical concerns:
- acknowledge concern
- provide verified policy
- offer direct follow-up channel

Do not publish private health information.

qa-compliance-guardrails.title: Q&A Compliance Guardrails
qa-compliance-guardrails.content_md:
### Guardrails
- No misleading promises
- No confidential resident information
- No discriminatory language
- Keep policy references current

Escalate uncertain responses to facility leadership before publishing.

billing-slot-management.title: Slot Management
billing-slot-management.content_md:
### Assignment rules
Your active plan controls premium slot count.

Unassign one facility before assigning another if slots are full.

billing-entitlement-errors.title: Billing and Entitlement Errors
billing-entitlement-errors.content_md:
### Error actions
- **ERR_SLOT_LIMIT**: Upgrade to increase slots.
- **ERR_PLAN_RESTRICTED**: View plans for required tier.
- **ERR_PENDING_PAYMENT**: Open billing and resolve outstanding balance.

Always use the in-UI CTA first.

billing-stripe-portal.title: Stripe Billing Portal
billing-stripe-portal.content_md:
### Portal capabilities
Update payment methods, review invoices, and manage subscription details in Stripe.

billing-assignment-troubleshooting.title: Assignment Troubleshooting
billing-assignment-troubleshooting.content_md:
### Common failures
- Slot limit reached
- Plan restriction
- Pending payment

### Resolution sequence
1. Read error code in banner.
2. Use mapped CTA.
3. Retry assignment after state update.

billing-upgrade-readiness-check.title: Upgrade Readiness Check
billing-upgrade-readiness-check.content_md:
### Before upgrading
- Confirm target facility list
- Confirm active slot utilization
- Confirm billing owner permissions
- Confirm payment method status

This avoids failed upgrades and rework.

billing-refund-and-dispute-policy.title: Refund and Dispute Policy
billing-refund-and-dispute-policy.content_md:
### Billing policy summary
For disputes, include invoice ID, charge date, amount, and issue summary in the first support request to speed resolution.

help-getting-started.title: Getting Started Checklist
help-getting-started.content_md:
### First-day checklist
1. Confirm profile basics and contact channels.
2. Complete pricing and amenities.
3. Add media and publish.
4. Review leads and Q&A daily.

help-account-security.title: Account Security
help-account-security.content_md:
### Security practices
- Use strong unique credentials.
- Restrict operator access by role.
- Review account activity regularly.

Report suspected unauthorized access immediately.

help-contact-support.title: Contact Support
help-contact-support.content_md:
### Required support packet
Include:
- Facility ID and name
- Exact timestamp and timezone
- Screenshot or screen recording
- Error code if present
- Steps to reproduce

This reduces first-response back-and-forth.

help-severity-and-escalation.title: Severity and Escalation
help-severity-and-escalation.content_md:
### Incident severity
- **P1**: Security, access, or critical data integrity
- **P2**: Core workflow blocked with workaround
- **P3**: Non-blocking defect or content issue

### Escalate when
- P1 unresolved immediately
- P2 unresolved in one business day
- repeated recurrence after fix

help-incident-report-template.title: Incident Report Template
help-incident-report-template.content_md:
### Template
- Summary
- Impacted users
- Start time
- Detection method
- Current status
- Mitigation applied
- Next checkpoint

Use this format for internal and support handoff consistency.

help-common-fixes-index.title: Common Fixes Index
help-common-fixes-index.content_md:
### Quick fixes
- Lead card stale: refresh statuses and wait one cycle
- Billing assignment failed: resolve mapped error code
- Q&A stale warning: update old answers
- Missing KPI: verify confidence threshold and source data volume

help-release-notes-and-changes.title: Release Notes and Change Awareness
help-release-notes-and-changes.content_md:
### Change discipline
Review release notes before weekly operations review. Note any metric definition or workflow behavior updates and align team SOPs.

help-training-plan-new-staff.title: Training Plan for New Staff
help-training-plan-new-staff.content_md:
### 7-day onboarding plan
Day 1: Dashboard orientation
Day 2: Lead workflow
Day 3: Q&A standards
Day 4: Listing quality control
Day 5: Billing basics
Day 6: Incident handling
Day 7: supervised execution

Require sign-off on each module before independent access.
